task.title: Review a complex policy configuration before export
task.shortdesc: Use a repeatable review flow for nested objects, arrays, raw fallback, conflicts, and channel-specific availability.

prereq.p: A profile is open and contains at least one complex policy family or managed preference.

context.p: Complex policies are safest when reviewed by family, source, schema channel, and exported boundary shape.

step.cmd: Open All settings and filter to the affected family.

info.p: Expected result: related policies, preferences, and source labels are visible together.

step.cmd: Check the Release/ESR badge for every policy in the family.

info.note: A Release-only policy must not be exported for an ESR-targeted profile.

step.cmd: Inspect nested object and array values, including unknown preserved fields.

info.p: Expected result: raw fallback values are intentionally kept or removed before save. For extensions, URLs/sites, and certificates/trust, return to Guided Steps 6, 2, and 4 respectively when the structured control applies.

step.cmd: Compare preset, CIS, imported, manual, and raw sources.

info.p: Expected result: conflicts are resolved deliberately rather than hidden by later edits.

step.cmd: Validate the profile and review the generated policies.json shape.

info.p: Expected result: BPM reports no schema errors for the selected channel.

result.p: The complex family has reviewed nested values, source decisions, channel support, and a clean validation result.

example.title: Current 0.9.6 behavior
example.p: Schema, preset, and CIS baseline are selected during preparation and remain read-only in the editor. For another saved profile, use explicit conversion or duplicate preparation; an unsupported or blocked case never silently drops values. Guided owners are Step 2 for URLs/sites, Step 4 for certificates and trust, and Step 6 for extensions.

postreq.p: If validation fails, return to the family, remove unsupported keys, or use explicit conversion to a schema that supports the policy. A conversion or duplicate blocker preserves the source and creates no converted target.
